opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants – Autumn round

amount.raw: Maximum grant up to £20,000 for New Projects and Commissions; up to £20,000 for Acquisitions and Collections; up to £5,000 for Conferences, Lectures and Publications; up to £2,500 for Research and Travel grants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK and international non‑profit organisations for exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, conferences, publications and research; individuals (sculpture historians, academics, conservators) may apply for Research and Travel grants.
opportunities.summary: Grants support the growth and development of sculpture, funding projects such as exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, conferences, publications and research, with maximum awards ranging from £2,500 to £20,000.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: UK – up to £600; Europe – up to £700; Rest of world – up to £1,000 (expenses allocation) plus accommodation.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to academics, curators, artists and scholars conducting research on historic or contemporary sculpture; UK‑based and international applicants; projects related to Henry Moore for Studios & Gardens fellowships.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enable researchers to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute or Studios & Gardens facilities, providing travel, subsistence and accommodation support.
